name: EPIC 212709771
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 17, 14.5 solar radii and 0.79 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212709771 (K2 campaign 17): PARAM radius (solar radii) 14.52241 (16th-84th percentiles 14.036409-15.284972), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212709771: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4774.7197 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212709771 (K2 campaign 17): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 6649.6875 (16th-84th percentiles 6483.59375-6875.078125), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.03 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 6,650 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 0.79 solar masses and 14.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,775 K at its surface.
